## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: record-review.sh derives STATUS=failed when any finding has severity critical, important, or fragile, and STATUS=passed when all findings are minor or findings array is empty
- DD3: The review-status file contains no score= line
- DD4: A minor finding whose description text contains the word 'critical' or 'important' does not cause STATUS=failed

## Files to modify
plugins/dso/hooks/record-review.sh

## Implementation (4 changes)

### Change 1: Replace embedded Python validator (lines ~262-350)

The current embedded Python script reads scores, validates them, and outputs:
  OK:<min_score>:<critical_flag>:<review_tier>:<selected_tier>:<files>

Replace with a new embedded Python script that:
1. Does NOT require or read a 'scores' key
2. Reads findings[].severity only
3. Determines pass/fail: any finding with severity critical/important/fragile = STATUS=failed; all minor or empty = STATUS=passed
4. Outputs a new OK line format:
   OK:<status>:<review_tier>:<selected_tier>:<files>
   (where <status> is 'passed' or 'failed', not a score)
5. The text content of finding descriptions MUST NOT affect STATUS (only the severity field matters)
6. Still validates required fields in findings objects (severity, category, file, description)

Example new logic:
  status = 'passed'
  for finding in findings:
      if finding.get('severity') in {'critical', 'important', 'fragile'}:
          status = 'failed'
          break
  print(f'OK:{status}:{review_tier}:{selected_tier}:{files_str}')

### Change 2: Parse the new OK format (lines ~359-370)

Change the parser from:
  SCORE="${RESULT_BODY%%:*}"
  REMAINDER="${RESULT_BODY#*:}"
  HAS_CRITICAL="${REMAINDER%%:*}"
  REMAINDER="${REMAINDER#*:}"
  REVIEW_TIER="${REMAINDER%%:*}"
  ...

To:
  STATUS_FROM_FINDINGS="${RESULT_BODY%%:*}"  # 'passed' or 'failed'
  REMAINDER="${RESULT_BODY#*:}"
  REVIEW_TIER="${REMAINDER%%:*}"
  REMAINDER="${REMAINDER#*:}"
  FINDINGS_SELECTED_TIER="${REMAINDER%%:*}"
  FILES_FROM_FINDINGS="${REMAINDER#*:}"

### Change 3: Remove score-based STATUS determination (lines ~748-752)

Remove:
  STATUS="passed"
  if [[ $(echo "$SCORE < 4" | bc -l) == "1" ]] || [[ "$HAS_CRITICAL" == "yes" ]]; then
      STATUS="failed"
  fi

Replace with:
  STATUS="$STATUS_FROM_FINDINGS"  # already determined by severity in Python

### Change 4: Remove score= from review-status write (lines ~760-770) and the --attest path (lines ~190-204)

**review-status write**: Remove the 'score=${SCORE}' line from the cat heredoc that writes the review-status file.

New review-status format:
  ${STATUS}
  timestamp=${TIMESTAMP}
  diff_hash=${DIFF_HASH}
  review_hash=${REVIEW_HASH}
  (no score= line)

**--attest path** (lines ~140-205): 
- Remove SOURCE_SCORE extraction
- Remove the check 'if [[ -z "$SOURCE_SCORE" ]]; then echo ERROR ...'
- Remove 'score=${SOURCE_SCORE}' from the written review-status
- Update the echo message: 'Review status attested from worktree X: passed (diff_hash=...)' (remove score from message)

### Additional changes

Update the header comment (lines 1-40):
- Change '- scores: object with hygiene, design...' → remove scores bullet
- Change 'Line 4: score=<min numeric score from review>' → remove this line
- Update the format documentation

Also: update the out-of-diff score-reset block (~lines 460-510) which reassigns scores after filtering. Since scores are gone, remove this entire block.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] record-review.sh does not write score= line to review-status
  Verify: ! grep -q '^score=' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/record-review.sh
- [ ] record-review.sh STATUS determination does not use bc -l for score comparison
  Verify: ! grep -q 'bc -l' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/record-review.sh
- [ ] test-record-review.sh passes (severity-based STATUS tests pass)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh
- [ ] test-record-review-attest.sh passes (no score= requirement in attest)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-record-review-attest.sh
- [ ] 2-key fixture with critical finding produces STATUS=failed
  Verify: ADIR=$(mktemp -d) WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR="$ADIR" bash -c 'F="$ADIR/reviewer-findings.json"; echo "{\"findings\":[{\"severity\":\"critical\",\"category\":\"correctness\",\"file\":\"foo.sh\",\"description\":\"bug\"}],\"summary\":\"bad\"}" > "$F"; HASH=$(shasum -a 256 "$F" | awk "{print \$1}"); bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/record-review.sh --reviewer-hash "$HASH" 2>&1; head -1 "$ADIR/review-status"' | tail -1 | grep -q "failed"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: GREEN: Implement record-review.sh severity-based STATUS, remove score= from review-status
